lines.text:
I’m on guard duty.
And I take my duty very seriously.
But, gee, am I ever thirsty!\c
I wish I had some [VAR COLOR(0006)]tea[VAR COLOR(0000)] to drink...
Oh, hold on there, kid.\nI’m afraid I can’t let you pass through here.
Oh, that tea you have...\nIt looks awfully tasty...
What? I can have a drink?\nGee, thanks!

*glug glug glug*\c
*glug glug glug*\c
Well... *glug glug*\c
If you really wanna go to Saffron City... *glug*\c
I guess I can let you past... *glug glug* *gulp*
I’ll share this tea with the guards working\nthe other gates around the city, too.
Oh, you’re that kid...\nThanks again for before!

Oh dear, I think I gave that poor guard too many
Pewter Crunchies to eat...\c
They’re rather dry if you don’t have any tea or
anything to wash them down...
There really is nothing like a hot cup of tea to\ngo with your Pewter Crunchies!
